answer: Alumni dues streak with university association records is the check: membership dues paid to the same alumni body every year. A farm faking 294 aliases needs 294 separate dues streaks, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The quartz test is the price tag: 294 fakes mean 294 payments. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The ripple signal is visible to every grader, and the hollow ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
